_status: DRAFT. Agency price ranges ('market') come from public 2026 pricing guides (see docs/pricing.md and the research notes). Mellon prices are the owner's pricing rule applied to those ranges. EVERYTHING ELSE here is invented for review: plan names, blurbs, timelines, feature lists, and what other agencies include. Replace with real facts before publishing. Ranges marked derived in docs/pricing.md (CA, SG, IE, AE mid-tiers for UI/UX) are interpolations, not quotes. Hourly and retainer cards (engagements): The hourly rate is INR 3,600, converted at the rates in docs/pricing.md; agency hourly ranges are derived from the hourly bands and retainer sources there, not quotes. The includes lists (30-minute billing, weekly report, roll-over hours, same designers) are invented. The retainer price is deliberately not in this file: the card shows 'quoted after a short call'. Retainer figures live only in docs/pricing.md. Plans for the other twelve services (branding, design systems, e-commerce, end-to-end, mobile app, motion, product, SaaS, UX audit, SEO, social, paid advertising): US agency ranges from public 2026 pricing guides; other locales use local figures where a source gave them and otherwise the US numbers times a rough local factor (GB 1, IN 20, AE 3, AU 1.2, CA 1.3, SG 1, IE 0.95), so treat those as estimates. Mellon is the market range times 0.9, rounded. All feature rows, names, timelines and 'what others include' are invented.
